page.overview:
Who is Joline Maza?

Joline Maza is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders, Blaeric Negina and Fen Mizar.

Joline is slender and pretty, with large brown eyes. She is taller than Merilille.

Joline is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She is relatively skilled in the Aes Sedai method of Healing, at least better at it than Teslyn.
